criteria.expected: Program, Event, workspace tab, focused task, and meaningful query/filter state are route and history owned; a valid return origin restores tab, search, filter, scroll and focus; an invalid or missing origin falls back to the Programs directory.
criteria.actual: Component coverage plus the candidate browser suite verifies route-owned task identity, valid Event/Participants return context, query/filter tab state, shell scroll restoration, and focused tab restoration across phone-360/390/402. Historical focused scroll artifacts remain labeled as predecessor applicability evidence.

criteria.expected: One-shot intents such as create Event are consumed with history replacement so Cancel cannot reopen them, and header actions are explicit open actions rather than toggles.
criteria.actual: consumeEventCreateIntent strips the hash with history.replaceState before opening, discard and toggle paths consume it too, and the header control renders only while the form is closed (web/lib/programs/workspace-events-task.tsx:184-199, :1821-1854, :2163-2174). Verified by the component cases plus the new real-browser journey 'consumes one-shot Event create intent and keeps Cancel closed' at 360/390/402.

criteria.expected: Event create/edit, Program Settings, Schedule Rule/exception, and Department Settings share one session-scoped Management Draft keyed by entity and action, cleared only after successful save, explicit discard, logout, or session end.
criteria.actual: management-draft.ts is the single store keyed entityId:action, every editor writes through it, saves and discards clear per action, and the logout/session-expiry boundary funnels through clearAllEventCreateDrafts (web/lib/programs/management-draft.ts:1-82, web/lib/app-shell.tsx:69,125,142,183). The delivery owner added the missing assertion: the sign-out component test seeds a Management Draft and asserts the read API returns null after Sign Out.
evidence: web/lib/app.test.tsx (sign-out clears the session Management Draft)

criteria.expected: Navigation that would unmount a dirty editor uses a shadcn AlertDialog offering Continue Editing or Discard and Leave; reload or browser interruption offers Recover or Discard; Save and Discard stay ordinary controls at the end of content, never sticky or floating.
criteria.actual: One capture-phase click plus beforeunload plus popstate guard renders the single Continue Editing / Discard and Leave dialog, and the create form offers Recover or Discard after reload (web/lib/programs/program-workspace.tsx:325-465, :1121-1155, web/lib/programs/workspace-events-task.tsx:2176-2199, web/lib/programs/department-settings-panel.tsx:440-467). No sticky or fixed utility remains in the five task/editor files. Verified by component cases and the new real-browser dirty/reload coverage at 360/390/402.

criteria.expected: Schedule enters and returns to the correct origin from Events versus Settings; Back and reload retain focused-task identity without storing form values in the URL.
criteria.actual: scheduleOrigin is serialized in the intent and preserved through navigation while only the editor kind and rule id are encoded (web/lib/programs/programs-intent.ts:568-572, :878-900, web/lib/programs/programs-boundary.tsx:996-999, :1131); the field-level tests round-trip the Settings origin and the Back-to-Events case. The Events-origin half is thinner than the Settings half.

criteria.expected: Participants initially selects Pending only when its count is nonzero, otherwise Active; returning restores its prior tab, search, filter, scroll, focus, and any durable interrupted Run.
criteria.actual: Component coverage plus the candidate browser suite verifies route-owned task identity, valid Event/Participants return context, query/filter tab state, shell scroll restoration, and focused tab restoration across phone-360/390/402. Historical focused scroll artifacts remain labeled as predecessor applicability evidence.

criteria.expected: The global top-right shell holds the only Participant/Management destination switch; Management Overview shows Program identity, current or next Event with its action, compact counts, then Add Event/Schedule/Settings.
criteria.actual: One shell control gated on the Programs route plus management capability lands on the other mode's directory and no page-local switch remains (web/lib/shell-header.tsx). Management Overview now orders Program identity, current/next Event and action, compact counts, then destinations (web/lib/programs/workspace-task.tsx).

criteria.expected: Settings Hub rows show authoritative concise current values for Basics, lifecycle/listing, Enrollment, Attendance timing, active Schedule count/next occurrence, and Notifications; Archive has its own capability-checked destructive confirmation.
criteria.actual: Every row renders a current value derived from the authoritative payload and the archive row is gated then confirmed in its own destructive dialog (web/lib/programs/program-settings.tsx:918, :931, :955, :994, :1009, :1029, :886, :1035-1086). The delivery owner added the missing assertion: a Settings Hub test now asserts the Basics, publishing, enrollment, attendance, schedule, and notification current values together.

criteria.expected: No Programs, filtered no-results, Rules without generated or upcoming Events, no Open Check-In Event, settled load failure, saved-but-stale, and permission denial are distinguished, each stating what is true and offering one actor-valid action.
criteria.actual: Distinct copy and states exist for each case; the delivery owner added the two missing assertions: the Events surface shows its truthful empty copy with the Schedule action when no Events are generated while the Rules-empty copy stays on the Schedule task, and the Schedule panel renders its no-Rules state without offering an unusable Preview.

criteria.expected: Notification links preserve normal and modifier-key navigation even when mark-read fails, and read state has an independent Retry that never implies completion of the underlying task.
criteria.actual: Modifier-key navigation remains native while mark-read runs independently. Normal primary clicks prevent the default, then continue navigation after markRead settles; markRead catches failed writes, preserving unread/error state and exposing an independent Retry, so a failed mark-read cannot block the real task (web/lib/programs/programs-notifications.tsx; web/lib/programs/programs-notifications.test.tsx).

criteria.expected: Department Settings separates loading, ready, failed, and saved-but-refresh-pending, and cannot discard another dirty controlled draft during a module action.
criteria.actual: The panel tracks detail/loadError/departmentSavedRefreshPending separately, restores its own draft through a Recover/Discard dialog, and runs module actions without resetting the controlled name/description draft (web/lib/programs/department-settings-panel.tsx:156-263, :179-192, :237-305, :440-467). Independent verifier re-ran the department-settings component suite including the settled load failure and module-action-keeps-dirty-draft cases.
